cases.title: Heavy-tail outlier defeats per-tensor symmetric RTN
cases.root_cause: A few large activations stretch the shared scale to cover the tail, collapsing resolution on the dense small-mass majority. Per-channel asymmetric + KL clip localises the scale and removes the tail.

cases.title: Tiny-magnitude weights: INT4 staircase noise dominates
cases.root_cause: With 16 INT4 levels the relative quantisation step is large relative to the signal; SQNR stays low even at high bit-efficiency. Mixed precision keeps such low-energy layers at INT8 (QuantFuse does this automatically via sensitivity).

cases.title: Per-row scale variation wastes per-tensor resolution
cases.root_cause: Rows have wildly different magnitudes; one shared scale is set by the largest row and starves the rest. Per-channel quantisation gives each row its own scale.
